steps.title: Analyze Camera Crash
steps.description: Identify missing Android M+ runtime camera permissions and Android 11+ package visibility query filter causing crash.

steps.title: Update Package Visibility Queries
steps.description: Add intent queries for MediaStore.ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE in AndroidManifest.xml for Android 11+ compliance.

steps.title: Implement Runtime Permission Checks
steps.description: Add checkSelfPermission and requestPermissions for android.permission.CAMERA before launching the camera intent.

steps.title: Add Permission Callback Handler
steps.description: Implement onRequestPermissionsResult to gracefully proceed to camera upon grant or alert user on denial.

steps.title: Defensive Camera Intent Launcher
steps.description: Wrap camera intent launch in safe try-catch blocks to prevent uncaught ActivityNotFoundException or SecurityException.

steps.title: Robust Image Capture Result Handling
steps.description: Support both intent extras thumbnail and direct content Uri fallbacks in onActivityResult.

steps.title: Gallery and File Safety Enhancements
steps.description: Enhance gallery picker error handling and null checks during document image loading.

steps.title: Storage Directory Validation
steps.description: Verify local document cache paths and temporary scan file creation safety.

steps.title: Verify UI State Transitions
steps.description: Ensure navigation tab switching and document list refreshing operate smoothly post-scan.

steps.title: Building DocScan Pro
steps.description: Compile the fixed Android application with all camera permission safeguards.
